title: Town Master
description:
Welcome to Town MasterYou've arrived at a magical little town — roll the dice, move along the track, collect materials, build shops, fulfill orders, and turn a small plot of land into a thriving commercial district.

The rules are simple, but the strategy runs deep: how you arrange your buildings, when you expand, whether or not to "visit" your friends — every decision can shape the course of the game.

And as a desktop game, it stays right on your desktop. You can let it run automatically or take control yourself — either way, it's the perfect companion for your workday.

Core GameplayGO — Roll to advance — Spend dice to move along the track. Land on different tiles to trigger coins, materials, mini-games, or special events.

Merge & Build — Drag identical shops together to upgrade them and produce more materials. Smart placement can also earn you extra bonuses.

Orders & Growth — Submit materials to complete orders, earn coins and experience, and unlock new areas, new shops, and new abilities.

Expand Your Town — Spend coins to expand your land, unlocking more building space and track, and watch your town grow bigger and bigger.

Partner Upgrades — Level up your pawn partner to unlock powerful skills and new appearances, making both management and adventure smoother.

Friend Interactions · Asynchronous SocialThis isn't traditional real-time multiplayer, but you'll truly feel that "you're not alone in town":

Add friends and check out each other's town progress.

Land on the "robbery" tile to visit a friend's home — steal materials or sabotage their buildings.

Hold up to 3 shields to block incoming attacks from friends.

The battle log records who stole from you and who damaged your shops — whether you seek revenge or reinforce your defenses, the choice is yours.

The leaderboard shows levels and overall strength — see who's the true Town Tycoon.

Track Mini-GamesAlong the way, you'll encounter all kinds of fun mini-games: catch the chick, find the duck, count the trees, whack-a-mole, treasure digging, and more…

Succeed and earn rewards; fail and don't fret — sometimes, landing on a few extra tiles in one round is more worthwhile than grinding through a single mini-game.

Home · Story · CollectiblesDecorate your rooms and complete tasks in the Home scene for a more complete town life experience.

Character stories and dialogues make the town feel like more than just a game board.

Photos and collections system tracks your management milestones.

Perfect for players who:Enjoy casual dice-rolling + management/merge gameplay.

Appreciate asynchronous social features like "build at your own pace, and occasionally cause a little trouble at a friend's place."

Are looking for a fun way to sneak in some gaming during work hours.

Roll the dice, take a step, collect a little, build a little —Your Town Master legend begins right here, from this very square.
description_short: This is a fun board game like Monopoly, where you build and expand your village by rolling the dice! You can also have real-time interactions with your friends!
